laws.rule: Parque Nacional Sipacate-Naranjo: the official visitor guidance asks passengers to ensure their boat service maintains reduced speed to avoid injuring turtles, especially in Poza del Nance. No numeric speed limit is published here. The guide's Acceso Libre field is not a 24-hour or fee-exemption assurance.

sources.title: Sipacate-Naranjo: turtle-safe boat conduct
sources.authority: Consejo Nacional de Áreas Protegidas, Guatemala
sources.supports: Read directly: boat service should maintain reduced speed to avoid injuring turtles, especially in Poza del Nance; Escuintla location.

local-law.note: Named turtle habitat only. This is the published boat-conduct guidance, not an invented numeric or general coastal law.
